name: Career Recommendation System
description: Skill-based career recommendations with transparent skill-match categories and Groq-generated explanations.
summary: Five weighted skill inputs pass through a persisted text classifier. Dataset-based skill matching produces impact categories, and a configured Groq integration generates the narrative explanation.
architecture: Streamlit collects five skills with primary/secondary weighting. A persisted CountVectorizer transforms skill text and a Multinomial Naive Bayes model predicts the career. Pandas looks up matching career skills; Groq generates narrative explanations using the configured API key. Skill-impact text is rule-based, not computed SHAP attribution.

capabilities.name: Career suggestions
capabilities.description: Process skill inputs into recommended career directions.

capabilities.name: Skill impact explanations
capabilities.description: Display skill-impact categories and generate narrative explanations through Groq.

stack.usage: Structured input and results views collect five skills and display recommendations.
predictor.py coordinates skill processing, prediction, and explanation output.
A configured Groq client generates a three-paragraph career explanation from matched skills and the predicted career.
CountVectorizer converts skill text to token counts; MultinomialNB predicts the career from persisted trained artifacts.
Pandas loads career_dataset.csv and selects primary and secondary skills for the predicted career.
Joblib persists and reloads model.pkl and vectorizer.pkl for skill classification.

architectureConnections.description: Collected skills enter the prediction orchestrator.
Recommendation context is passed to the explanation provider.
The trained vectorizer and Naive Bayes classifier are saved and reloaded as model artifacts.

evidence.notes: Reviewed public README, requirements.txt, predictor.py, and train_model.py. The estimator is CountVectorizer plus MultinomialNB. Skill-impact statements use matching rules, not the SHAP package. The current prediction function requires a configured Groq API key.
